tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.desc: Background of the channel list and the member list.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.desc: Background of the chat and of cards.

tokens.name: elevated
tokens.desc: Raised surfaces: inputs, popups, hovered cards.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.desc: Secondary text (channel names, times). The app raises its contrast when it's too low.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.desc: Tertiary text and hints. The app raises its contrast when it's too low.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.desc: The highlight color: selection, buttons, focus.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.desc: Text drawn on top of accent.

tokens.name: online
tokens.desc: Online status, and the ring around who is speaking.

tokens.name: idle
tokens.desc: Idle status (and the mention highlight in some layouts).

patterns.desc: Overrides a color token on this node and its children: c-text="#fff".
Like c-, only in light mode.
Like c-, only in dark mode.

condition.desc: The node only applies in this mode.
The node only applies when this theme option is on (modo-claro and modo-escuro also work).
The node only applies when this theme option is off.

node.desc: Fixed width (in a row: the size along the row).
Fixed height (in a column: the size along the column).
Weight in the space left over by the fixed sizes.
Limits the width and centers the node.
Hides the node when the window is narrower than this.
Hides the node when the window is shorter than this.
Shows the node only when the window is shorter than this.
Shows the node only when this theme option is on (modo-claro and modo-escuro also work).
Shows the node only when this theme option is off.
A named style from styles, drawn behind the node.
Background: a token name or a color expression.
Corner radius of bg and of the primitives on this node.

container.desc: Inner space on the left and right (instead of padding).
Inner space at the top and bottom (instead of padding).

component.desc: Inner margin of the component, left and right.
Inner margin of the component, top and bottom.
The component's font: mono, ui or any installed family.
The component fades out until the mouse gets close.

box.desc: Gradient of 2 or 3 colors separated by spaces.
Gradient angle in degrees: 0 left to right, 90 top to bottom.
Repeating pattern; needs pattern-color.
Color of the pattern.
Distance between repeats of the pattern.
Stroke thickness (or dot radius) of the pattern.
Fine noise tinted by this color.
Darkens (or tints) the edges.
Where the vignette starts: 0 at the center, 1 only in the corners.
Inward shadow.
Size of the inward shadow.
Soft hollow shadow: it doesn't darken what's under a translucent panel.
Size of the drop shadow.
Vertical offset of the drop shadow.
Background drawn on top when the mouse is over it, with a transition.
Gradient border of 2 or 3 colors.
Angle of the gradient border, in degrees.
Border thickness.
Border on the top side only.
Border on the right side only.
Border on the bottom side only.
Border on the left side only.
Thickness of the top border (default: border-width, or 1).
Thickness of the right border (default: border-width, or 1).
Thickness of the bottom border (default: border-width, or 1).
Thickness of the left border (default: border-width, or 1).
Which corners the fill rounds.

top.name: theme
top.desc: Metadata: the name and what shows in Settings.
top.pt: Metadados: o nome e o que aparece nas Configurações.

props.desc: SPDX license identifier (the community gallery asks for one; the app ignores it).
Which thumbnail Settings draws for the theme.

top.name: theme-api
top.desc: Version of the theme format. 2 = strict: unknown components, properties and values are errors. Without it, 1: they're warnings.
top.pt: Versão do formato do tema. 2 = estrito: componentes, propriedades e valores desconhecidos são erros. Sem ele, 1: são avisos.

top.name: extends
top.desc: Starts from another theme (built-in or in your themes folder) and changes only what differs.
top.pt: Parte de outro tema (embutido ou da sua pasta de temas) e muda só o que for diferente.

args.desc: Name of the base theme, like "classico".

top.name: palette
top.desc: The 16 base colors (wal:0 … wal:15): "wal" for pywal's, or up to 16 hex colors.
top.pt: As 16 cores base (wal:0 … wal:15): "wal" para as do pywal, ou até 16 cores hex.

top.name: colors
top.desc: Overrides color tokens: one child per token, with a color expression.
top.pt: Sobrescreve tokens de cor: um filho por token, com uma expressão de cor.

top.name: roles
top.desc: Up to 8 role colors (usernames, server icons).
top.pt: Até 8 cores de cargo (nomes, ícones de servidor).

top.name: fonts
top.desc: Font families and the base size.
top.pt: Famílias de fonte e o tamanho base.

top.name: metrics
top.desc: Default rounding of rows and buttons.
top.pt: Arredondamento padrão de linhas e botões.

props.desc: Transparent window background (the compositor can blur what's behind it on Linux).

top.name: styles
top.desc: Named styles to use with style=name.
top.pt: Estilos nomeados para usar com style=nome.

top.name: options
top.desc: On/off switches the theme offers in Settings → Appearance.
top.pt: Chaves liga/desliga que o tema oferece em Configurações → Aparência.

top.name: vars
top.desc: Variables: one child per variable (a number, a string or a color expression), used as $name in values. A theme that extends this one can change them.
top.pt: Variáveis: um filho por variável (número, texto ou expressão de cor), usadas como $nome nos valores. Um tema que estende este pode trocá-las.

props.desc: The variables only apply in this mode.

top.name: layout
top.desc: The interface tree, with a single root (row, column, stack or a component).
top.pt: A árvore da interface, com uma raiz só (row, column, stack ou um componente).

props.desc: Border color when the mouse is over it.
Glass reflection at the top of the card.

children.name: option
children.desc: An on/off switch in Settings → Appearance.
children.pt: Uma chave liga/desliga em Configurações → Aparência.

args.desc: The option's name (used as when=name and $name).

children.name: span
children.desc: A piece of the label's line, with its own color, weight, size or font.
children.pt: Um pedaço da linha do label, com cor, peso, tamanho ou fonte próprios.

props.desc: Extra space between letters (inherits from the label).

containers.name: stack
containers.desc: Children on top of each other (the first one is drawn first).
containers.pt: Filhos um por cima do outro (o primeiro é desenhado antes).

components.name: guild-bar
components.desc: The server bar.
components.pt: A barra de servidores.

props.desc: Bar, macOS-style dock or list with names.
How the server icons are filled.
Shape of the icons; text = tabs with the names.

components.name: channel-list
components.desc: The server's channels (or the DM list).
components.pt: Os canais do servidor (ou a lista de DMs).

props.desc: Colored banner with the server name (variant=discord).

components.name: user-panel
components.desc: Your name, status, mute/deafen and the settings button.
components.pt: Seu nome, status, mudo/surdo e o botão de configurações.

components.name: header
components.desc: Channel name, topic and buttons above the chat.
components.pt: Nome do canal, tópico e botões em cima da conversa.

components.name: tabs
components.desc: Open conversations as tabs.
components.pt: Conversas abertas em abas.

components.name: messages
components.desc: The conversation (and the call screen when a voice channel is open).
components.pt: A conversa (e a tela da call quando um canal de voz está aberto).

props.desc: Named style for each tile of the call screen.
How much of each person's photo color goes into the call tile.

components.name: composer
components.desc: The text box.
components.pt: A caixa de texto.

components.name: member-list
components.desc: Members of the server (or the profile in a DM).
components.pt: Membros do servidor (ou o perfil numa DM).

components.name: status-bar
components.desc: A status line: connection, ping, memory, voice, theme, keys, clock.
components.pt: Uma linha de status: conexão, ping, memória, voz, tema, atalhos, relógio.

props.default: conn ping ram voice spacer theme keys clock
props.desc: What the bar shows, in order; after spacer it goes to the right. me, mic and deaf: your status and the mute/deafen buttons.

components.name: label
components.desc: A line of text, with display typography (tracking, spans, shadow, outline, gradient).
components.pt: Uma linha de texto, com tipografia de display (tracking, spans, sombra, contorno, degradê).

props.desc: Text color: a token name or a color expression.
Extra space between letters, in pixels (can be negative).
Text shadow; with shadow-blur it becomes a soft halo.
Vertical offset of the shadow (default 1, or 0 with shadow-blur).
Gradient on the text, 2 or 3 colors.
Angle of the text gradient (default: horizontal).

components.name: logo
components.desc: The app logo, in ASCII or as a wordmark.
components.pt: O logo do app, em ASCII ou como texto.

components.name: topbar
components.desc: Top bar: back/forward between tabs, search and help.
components.pt: Barra de cima: voltar/avançar entre abas, busca e ajuda.

components.name: crt
components.desc: Scanlines and vignette on top of everything (use it in a stack).
components.pt: Linhas de varredura e vinheta por cima de tudo (use num stack).

components.name: shape
components.desc: A drawn shape: circle, ring, arc, rounded rectangle or line.
components.pt: Uma forma desenhada: círculo, anel, arco, retângulo arredondado ou linha.

props.desc: Diameter (default: the node's shorter side); on line, the length.
Start of the arc, in degrees.
Opening of the arc, in degrees.
A dot at the tip of the arc.
Tilt of the line, in degrees.

components.name: rule
components.desc: A rule: plain, dashed, dotted, double, newspaper or ornamented.
components.pt: Uma régua: lisa, tracejada, pontilhada, dupla, de jornal ou com ornamento.

props.desc: From top to bottom (give the node a width).
A shape in the middle of the rule.
A character in the middle, instead of the shape (uses the node's font).
Gap in the rule around the ornament.

components.name: window-controls
components.desc: The three window buttons (close, minimize, maximize), which really work.
components.pt: Os três botões da janela (fechar, minimizar, maximizar), que funcionam de verdade.

components.name: starfield
components.desc: Procedural background: stars (first child of a stack).
components.pt: Fundo procedural: estrelas (primeiro filho de um stack).

props.desc: Moves slowly (stops with Reduce motion, minimized or out of focus). Best as "$option".
Frames per second of the motion.

components.name: orbit
components.desc: Procedural background: orbits with moons.
components.pt: Fundo procedural: órbitas com luas.

props.desc: Horizontal center, as a fraction of the width.
Vertical center, as a fraction of the height.
Moves slowly (stops with Reduce motion, minimized or out of focus). Best as "$option".
Frames per second of the motion.

components.name: radar
components.desc: Procedural background: radar rings and sweep.
components.pt: Fundo procedural: anéis e varredura de radar.

props.desc: Horizontal center, as a fraction of the width.
Vertical center, as a fraction of the height.
Moves slowly (stops with Reduce motion, minimized or out of focus). Best as "$option".
Frames per second of the motion.

components.name: topography
components.desc: Procedural background: contour lines (always still).
components.pt: Fundo procedural: curvas de nível (sempre paradas).

components.name: aurora
components.desc: Procedural background: two curtains of light.
components.pt: Fundo procedural: duas cortinas de luz.

props.desc: Moves slowly (stops with Reduce motion, minimized or out of focus). Best as "$option".
Frames per second of the motion.

components.name: dunes
components.desc: Procedural background: hills from back to front (the sky is the gradient of the node around it).
components.pt: Fundo procedural: morros do fundo para a frente (o céu é o gradiente do nó em volta).

props.desc: Moves slowly (stops with Reduce motion, minimized or out of focus). Best as "$option".
Frames per second of the motion.

components.desc: Empty space.
components.pt: Espaço vazio.
